body:
1. A pet gets sick when it stays very unhappy for a long time (about 1 more hour of play at the bottom).
2. It counts real play minutes, only while you play. Away = paused.
3. It shows by body language only: droops, walks slowly, lies down, sneezes. Only the vet booking screen lists your sick pets.
4. Friends see your pets as the real thing: the same sick look, moods and moves.
5. No tricks or Pet Show until cured.
6. Only the vet cures it. It never dies or runs away.
7. Ms. Paws won't take a sick pet: "Let's get her well first."
8. It doesn't spread.
9. Old saves: all pets start healthy; happiness stays.

Game rules chat: Got it. Sick only when it isn't fed AND isn't played with for long (both). If you meant either one, press Redo.

short: Sick when very unhappy for a long time
